messages:
maya: FYI during coral-v1 q4 bring-up I hit a small but consistent bidi issue: when Japanese text contains a short Hebrew quoted phrase the closing bracket/quote gets mirrored after quant. repro on canary.

maya: repro (canary coral-v1.q4): curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/canary/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' -d '{"model":"coral-v1.q4","input":"\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e (\u05e4\u05e8\u05e7) \u3067\u3059"}'

ravi: expected (fp16/int8): \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e (\u05e4\u05e8\u05e7) \u3067\u3059
maya: observed (q4): \u65e5\u672c\u8a9e ((\u05e4\u05e8\u05e7)) \u3067\u3059  <-- extra paren/flip. BLEU down from 6.8->4.1 on jp-hebrew-mix set.

akiko: token dump from canary q4: tokens: ["\u65e5\u672c\u8a9e"," ","(","\u05e4","\u05e8","\u05e7"," ",")"," ","\u3067","\u3059"] ; bidi: [LTR,WS,ON,RTL,RTL,RTL,WS,ON,WS,LTR,LTR]. ON tokens adjacent to RTL.

ravi: sounds like kvcache index packing for small ON tokens in the q4 kernel shifted offsets. int8/fp16 unaffected. starting bisect on q4 kernel commits.

l10n-bot: created locale set "jp-hebrew-paren" (520 ex). baseline: coral-v1.fp16 BLEU 6.8; coral-v1.q4 BLEU 4.1; coral-v1.int8 BLEU 6.7. saved fails to /datasets/locale-onboard/jp-hebrew-paren/fails-3234567890.json

diag-bot: bisect job started. ETA ~30m.

ravi: bisect points to short-token alignment change. quick patch: disable packing for ON tokens near strong-RTL. hotfix built and canary-deployed.

diag-bot: canary results: coral-v1.q4-hotfix BLEU 6.6 (fp16 6.8). spot-check: no bracket flips.

akiko: opening PR with unit tests for RTL-surrounded ON, ZWJ/ZWNJ cases and adding a CI guard running jp-hebrew-paren on q4 kernel changes.

maya: thanks, leaving a 48h canary monitor and a routing soft-rule preferring int8 for mixed CJK+RTL until stable.
